native_mechanisms: A growing append-only chain hung between fire and wall, so each new shadow depends on the entire accumulated row, not just the newest knot
Each mark's own pebble-count (popcount of its strokes) sets how far the incense swings, bending/displacing where the firelight lands before it hits the wall
Only the wet-clay print of the settled shadow, hardened in the stream and read by its ridges, is kept as the token; smoke, pebble-cup and prior print are discarded
core_technique: Six-lane rotate/xor ring accumulator fed by a 256-entry byte table whose entries are (b|0x100) shifted left by 6*popcount(b), then a linear/nonlinear lane fold and a standard SplitMix64/Murmur3 fmix64 multiply-xor-shift finalizer.
